label: Günlük challenge
example: ==Although== the ==deadline== was tight, we ==managed to== finish the report.
cta: Senin cümlen yorumlara! En iyisini paylaşacağım

meta.caption:
Günlük Challenge #12 🔥

Bu 3 kelimeyi tek bir cümlede kullan:
1️⃣ although
2️⃣ deadline
3️⃣ manage to

Örnek: Although the deadline was tight, we managed to finish the report.

Senin cümlen yorumlara 👇 En iyi cümleyi story'de paylaşacağım!

Daily challenge: use all 3 words in one sentence.
